## DPStyleARWebLive.initialize() method

Initialize the internal settings required for StyleAR virtual try-on. This method sets up the StyleAR environment, loads necessary WebAssembly modules, and prepares the system for virtual try-on functionality.

**Signature:**

```typescript
initialize(setting?: DPStyleARSettingInterface, progress?: DPStyleARProgressListener): Promise<void>;
```
